questions.q: When does General Ledger validate a journal?
options: When you try to mark it complete, before it can post
After it posts, as a cleanup step
Only once a year during audit
Only for journals from the Manual source
questions.explain: Validation happens at completion time, before posting — a failed journal simply stays Incomplete.

questions.q: What is a cross-validation rule violation?
options: Using an account combination that doesn't exist at all
A combination of individually valid segment values that are not allowed to be paired together
Entering a journal in a closed period
questions.explain: A cross-validation rule blocks specific pairings of segment values that are each valid on their own.

questions.q: If the error says 'Period status is Closed,' what should you check?
options: The journal's accounting date against the period's status
questions.explain: A closed-period error points at the accounting date, not the account or amount.

questions.q: In the Solara Fixtures cross-validation example, why is Cost Center 500 + Company 01 blocked?
options: Because both values are individually valid, but that specific pairing isn't allowed
questions.explain: Both the cost center and company are valid values on their own; the cross-validation rule blocks that specific combination.

questions.q: What status does a journal stay in when it fails validation?
questions.explain: A journal that fails validation remains Incomplete and never updates a balance.
